outputs.description: The fixed settings the Electron renderer uses to open its WebSocket to its own main process, which never leaves the machine and carries the same wire messages as a phone's channel, in plain text frames. A client connects at path `/v1/local` with protocol `harness.v1` from origin `harness://app` (the only page allowed to connect), carries its one-use ticket as a second subprotocol prefixed `ticket.` (never in the address, never stored), and the timing and limits are `ticketMs` 10000 ms, `tickets` 8 waiting tickets over all windows, `clients` 4, `streams` 8 messages one side may have in flight, and `requestBytes` 1114112 (a game document of at most 1 MiB plus a 65536-byte envelope allowance).
